newsitem.title: USA: FedEx buys Arrow, Florida West Argentina sp.
newsitem.headline: FedEx buys Arrow, Florida West Argentina sp.

text.p: Federal Express Corp. has reached agreement with Arrow Air Inc. and Florida West International Airlines to purchase their all cargo frequency allocations to Argentina, Federal Express said on Tuesday.

"The additional frequencies give us the flexibility to further strengthen our global network," Joseph McCarty, Federal Express senior vice president for Latin America and the Caribbean said in the announcement.
FedEx is buying one weekly flight from Florida West and two from Arrow. Both carriers are privately-held all-cargo carriers based in Miami.
The transfer of these frequencies is subject to the United States Department of Transportation approval. The approval of the boards of all three companies are also required.
FedEx already flies once daily to and from Argentina. The agreement could add three flights per week. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
